verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a built-in, purpose-built infrastructure agent. Users tell it what they need in plain English, and it handles dependencies, executes changes and monitors outcomes. Tasks can also be delegated to Neo from external coding assistants through the official MCP server. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Neo's task-delegation workflow (approvals, scope, controls beyond marketing claims), independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as described.
